authors: Oh, Joo Hwan; Kwon, Young Eui; Lee, Hyung Jin; Kim, Yoon Young
title: Elastic metamaterials for independent realization of negativity in density and stiffness
what_it_establishes: Effective mass m_eff = m1 + m3 w^2/(wx^2 - w^2) (eq. 4a, p.4) is frequency dependent and negative above the local resonance; rho_eff = m_eff/(d h^2) (p.5).
limitation: Supports the wording 'commonly described by', not the Liu 2000 attribution, which stays unverified.

authors: Gupta, Vipin; Hussain, Syed Modassir; Yaylaci, Murat; Das, Soumik
title: Heat map analysis of wave dynamics in nonlocal Kelvin-Voigt piezo-semiconductors under memory-dependent heat flux
what_it_establishes: Heat flux law (2.15) p.6 carries the memory-dependent three-phase-lag kernel and the KG nonlocal operator; its elimination (2.16) p.6 and the carrier eq. (2.17) p.6 show the kernel living inside a piezo-semiconductor model.
limitation: Already present in the package as Gupta2026HeatMap; not cited in s12b_wider.tex - recommend citing it.
